dog.description_text:
Age: 10 years
Size: 18 lbs
Good with: kids, cats, dogs.

Abandoned by her previous owner and found wandering alone in town, In the Mood for Love was brought to an over-capacity shelter and slated for euthanasia due to her age. We rescued her just in time and discovered what a gem she is! This golden senior is as sweet as can be - she loves everyone she meets and gets along nicely with dogs and cats. She loves to be held, snuggled and kissed - grateful for every bit of attention that comes her way. Although shes hard of hearing and has a Grade 4 heart murmur, she's still full of life and eager to explore the world around her.

In the Mood for Love is fostered in Brooklyn, NY and is available for local or out-of-state adoption as long as the adopter can travel to meet her. To get the adoption process started, please send us an application at https://bit.ly/rosr-adopt-foster.
dog.name: In the Mood for Love
